title: Business Analytics in Online BCom | DSU Online Elective
description: Advance your career with a UGC-entitled Online B.Com in Business Analytics from DSU. Master data visualization, predictive modeling and strategic decision-making

blocks.x: Data Science | Visualization | Predictive Modelling | Decision Intelligence

Business Analytics equips learners with analytical, technical, and strategic skills to transform data into actionable business insights. This elective provides hands-on learning in data management, visualization, and predictive modelling for effective decision-making. The specialization integrates data science, statistical techniques, and business intelligence to prepare learners for high-growth careers in analytics, consulting, marketing intelligence, finance, operations, and digital transformation. With a strong focus on real-world datasets, industry tools, and practical projects, the program builds expertise demanded by modern organisations.
Data cleaning, preprocessing, database handling, and foundational analytics workflows.
Creating dashboards and insights using tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Python libraries.
Statistical modelling, machine learning techniques, forecasting, and decision-making models.
Transforming data into insights for marketing, finance, operations, and strategic planning.
Big data tools, real-world datasets, optimization techniques, and digital transformation analytics.
